policy.preferred: CC0, then CC-BY with attribution, then project-owned/generated

sources.name: Kenney
sources.notes: Game-ready packs; check each pack page.

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.notes: HDRIs, PBR textures, models; record exact asset URL.

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.notes: PBR materials; check map set and resolution.

sources.name: Quaternius
sources.notes: Low-poly packs; check scale and rig.

sources.name: OpenGameArt
sources.notes: Per-asset licence is authoritative; record author and licence URL.

sources.name: Freesound
sources.notes: Reject NC for commercial use; record sound ID and licence.

sources.name: Pixabay
sources.notes: Check current licence; avoid identifiable people/brands.

sources.name: Mixamo
sources.notes: Account required; check redistribution/engine terms; record clip ID.

sources.name: itch.io Free Assets
sources.notes: Read each page; many are custom licences.

sources.name: Unity Asset Store
sources.notes: Free/paid EULA is not open source; requires approval and licence record.

sources.name: Sketchfab
sources.notes: Filter by downloadable + licence; reject NC for commercial.

sources.name: NVIDIA SimReady Central
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (per dataset; verify exact card)
sources.notes: OpenUSD simulation-ready assets on Hugging Face. Manual selection only; dataset can be multi-GB, above the 20MB asset-fetch cap. Verify each OEM dataset licence, import via Blender and export GLB.

sources.name: ThreeJS Assets — free tier
sources.license: Free Commercial License (project use; no resale/mirror/redistribution)
sources.notes: 937 free web-optimized GLB assets; verify the exact asset page/pack exceptions; never mirror or redistribute files or download access. MCP connector requires a signed-in account.

sources.name: Polyfork
sources.license: free (verify the per-pack terms before commercial use)
sources.notes: 2,600+ parametric game-ready glTF models, +200/week. Parameters cover colour, wear, season and state, so one model can be authored to the art bible instead of recoloured by hand. Intake 2026-10-27 (x.com/Polyfork3d).
